text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Come to the trainer's office tomorrow 
morning, you say?
choice_data_list:
I just need to hand over some documents, 
so it won't take long.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Understood completely! There is no need to 
worry! I shall arrive without fail before 
the appointed hour!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I-I overslept--!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"However, if I run, I'll make it just in 
time!! To the Trainer's office, swift as 
lightning!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat~!? The morning school rush, you 
say!? There is quite a crowd near the 
entrance...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait! Calm down, me! There's gotta 
be a winning move if I search for it... 
Mm?!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is Sir Brian... It seems she has 
just returned from her run.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Divine revelation!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaâ¡â¡â¡ Look at that! It's 
Brian-san! She's returning to the school 
building~~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, true. She really does have an 
intimidating aura, doesn't she~. —She's 
just too cool, walking in front of her is 
out of the question... —We'd better step 
to the side so we don't get in her way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! The path has opened up nicely! Now I 
can run!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ? What in the world...?

To fulfill my promise with No Reason, I 
headed over to the Trainer's Office, and—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, what do we have here~? Isn't 
the Trainer the slower one here~?"
choice_data_list: Ooh~! Quick as always, I see.
Ooh~! Quick as always, I see.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Who do you think I am?! 
Nya-ha-ha-ha! ...Whew.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwoah!? Did we run into a massive crowd 
again?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Howevvver! Such an outcome was fully 
anticipated! Now, to the secret escape 
route only I know about!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, the classrooms around here are 
under renovation...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(If I leave the back door open for the 
delivery vendors—)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mhm, this is the door!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Shaved off some time! All that's 
left is to dash for the Trainer's room!

To fulfill my promise with No Reason, I 
headed over to the Trainer's Office, and—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, what do we have here~? Once 
again, isn't the Trainer the slower one 
here~?"
choice_data_list: You're quick again this time, huh~~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha-ha! 'Tis all thanks to keeping 
my ears perked day in and day out, I say!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
All right! Thanks to the construction, the 
back gate is open again! Now that's a 
shortcut~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what in the world~~!? There is a 
whole mountain of scrap wood and junk 
here!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You just tossed it there carelessly 
because it's somewhere you don't use 
often, didn't you?! Honestly, the nerve!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... When I dropped by on a whim, who 
should I find behind all this junk but the 
greatest mastermind of our time?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, Lord Gimlet? —No, this is an 
opportunity!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, is your path blocked as well? Thanks 
to that fool, we are both in quite a 
bind~.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Nonsense. I am the one who shall 
liberate all. There exists no "fence" in 
this world that can bind me—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!!

When I headed to the Trainer's room at the 
appointed time, No Reason was already 
there waiting.
choice_data_list: You're as fast as ever, huh~

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Right?! Right?! Nyahaha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Hmph. Just to be safe, I should see if 
there are any other ways out besides that 
back door...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Thanks to the new shortcut, all is 
going smoothly! Why, we even have time to 
spare before the appointed hour♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's tidy myself up a little 
bit... ...wait, what...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gah, gehh!? Bedhead, of all things?! I can 
hardly look the part like this!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Should I fix it with water? ...No, that 
might expose the flaw.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If that be so, I request thy 
reinforcement! As for someone nearby in 
these classrooms who might be of aid――!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa♡♡ No Reason-san made a promise with 
someone special to her~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to Maya, then! I've got hair 
mist, so I can fix it up in a flash!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Lady Mayano! Such a mature 
woman~!

When I headed to the Trainer's room at the 
appointed time, No Reason was already 
there waiting. Her hair seemed slightly 
damp.
choice_data_list: Is your hair not cooperating today?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Just like usual, right! Grooming 
is the ABCs of horse racing after all~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the shortcut, everything's going 
smoothly! No bedhead either! Just one last 
push to the Trainer's office!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, No Reason-senpai! Stop, stooop~~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's so slippery up ahead that I can't 
move forward. Looks like someone spilled 
liquid soap...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat~~!? Take a detour then!? No, no, we 
won't make it in time if we do that...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Hm!? Lady Dantsu, what are that bucket 
and cloth for?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This? I was just trying to wipe off as 
much of the soap as I could.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—...! Allow me to lend a hand with that 
cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-senpaaai! Wiping the floor with 
your feet is dangerous~~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gliding across the floor, slick as ice! 
Straight shot to the Trainer's 
Room—whoaaa?!

When I headed to the Trainer's room at the 
appointed time, No Reason was there 
rubbing her head.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' much, just bumped it a wee bit... 
Ouch. ...Maybe I oughta make that move 
forbidden.
